title: Streets of New Capenna: card flavor text

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: A city-plane ruled by five crime families under demonic masters, built in tiers with wealth and power at the top.

entities.name: Old Capenna
entities.description: The earlier city whose secrets are held by New Capenna's statues; the Brokers descend from its paladins.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: A prized, smuggled substance or power in New Capenna that flows through the Cabaretti and through Giada.

entities.name: Giada
entities.description: A teenage girl who is the source of the Cabaretti's Halo; something long dormant awakens within her.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: A planeswalker in New Capenna who was branded the most dangerous criminal in the city; she helps Giada escape and talks with Xander.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A planeswalker and demon who seeks to seize New Capenna by usurping its hidden power networks.

entities.name: Adversary
entities.description: A figure whose forces descended upon the gala.

entities.name: Lord Xander
entities.description: Leader of the Maestros, found dead in a news cry; he recruits Elspeth as a spy.

entities.name: Maestros
entities.description: One of the five crime families; the first to fall to Ob Nixilis.

entities.name: Jetmir
entities.description: A leader of the Cabaretti who demands loyalty.

entities.name: Cabaretti
entities.description: A crime family that cultivates an image of harmless hedonism while hiding formidable firepower.

entities.name: Jinnie Fay
entities.description: Jetmir's second, who watches his back.

entities.name: Rocco
entities.description: The Cabaretti's caterer.

entities.name: Ziatora
entities.description: Leader of the Riveteers who desires only more.

entities.name: Riveteers
entities.description: A crime family of builders and wreckers, attracting young viashino.

entities.name: Ognis
entities.description: Ziatora's second-in-command.

entities.name: Mr. Orfeo
entities.description: A tough Riveteers figure once jumped by a dozen Maestros agents.

entities.name: Raffine
entities.description: Leader of the Obscura, who foresees her enemies' moves.

entities.name: Obscura
entities.description: A crime family of spies and information, based in the Cloud Spire.

entities.name: Cloud Spire
entities.description: The Obscura's tower that dominates the skyline.

entities.name: Kamiz
entities.description: An Obscura Oculus.

entities.name: Altonio
entities.description: An Obscura figure who has disappeared.

entities.name: Falco Spara
entities.description: Leader of the Brokers who recruits by saving strangers.

entities.name: Brokers
entities.description: A crime family of masters of defensive combat and secrets, descended from Old Capenna's paladins.

entities.name: Nido Sanctuary
entities.description: The Brokers' headquarters, seen as an office complex.

entities.name: Anhelo
entities.description: An assassin who speaks on the trade.

entities.name: Gregorio
entities.description: A character who struck a deal with Mikey.

entities.name: Mikey the Mouth
entities.description: A man who kept his nickname after striking a deal with Gregorio and never spoke again.

entities.name: Gino
entities.description: A hired kidnapper.

entities.name: Inspector Jillard
entities.description: An inspector hoping for divine intervention.

entities.name: Ginsi the Thief
entities.description: A deceased thief.

entities.name: Krandal
entities.description: A freelance instigator.

entities.name: Glunk
entities.description: A freelance crusher.

entities.name: Conzuelo
entities.description: A restaurant critic.

entities.name: Calvey
entities.description: A funeral director.

entities.name: Kitt Kanto
entities.description: A singer who survived assassins with a sustained note.

entities.name: Queza
entities.description: A figure who reweaves fate to her own design.

entities.name: Cormela
entities.description: A thief who sees the world as a gift for her.

entities.name: Balzano
entities.description: A rhox security guard.

entities.name: Vantoleone
entities.description: A figure whose family was attacked, shattering the balance of power.

entities.name: Vanto Beatdown
entities.description: A citywide obsession that began as a dance-battle at the Rose Room.

entities.name: Rose Room
entities.description: A lounge where the Vanto Beatdown began.

entities.name: Park Heights
entities.description: The affluent district of New Capenna with angel statues on its rooftops.

entities.name: Caldaia
entities.description: A gritty borough of New Capenna with tunnels beneath its streets.

entities.name: Mezzio
entities.description: A borough with bazaar-like street corners.

entities.name: Beamtown Bullies
entities.description: A group reported spotted in the Mezzio.

entities.name: Treza
entities.description: A sprawling warehouse used as the Riveteers' proving ground.

entities.name: Shadow Hostel
entities.description: An opulent hostel where Maestros agents lie low.

entities.name: Museum of Old Capenna
entities.description: A museum with a great library hiding passages.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis closes in on Giada; Halo sweeps through her and something long dormant awakens inside her.
events.quote: As Ob Nixilis closed in, Halo swept through Giada like an electrical current, and inside her, something long dormant unfurled its wings.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis decides to seize New Capenna by usurping its hidden power networks, and the Maestros fall first.
events.quote: Xander's Maestros were the first to fall.

events.summary: A news crier announces that Lord Xander has been found dead.
events.quote: "Breaking news! Lord Xander found dead! Suspect at large!"

events.summary: As the Adversary's forces descend on the gala, Elspeth offers to get Giada out.
events.quote: As the Adversary's forces descended upon the gala, Elspeth whispered to Giada, "I can get you out of here, but we have to go now."

events.summary: Elspeth is branded the most dangerous criminal in New Capenna.
events.quote: Overnight, Elspeth was branded the most dangerous criminal in New Capenna.

events.summary: Elspeth seeks answers while Xander needs a spy, and their paths cross.
events.quote: Elspeth wanted answers. Xander needed a spy.

events.summary: The attack on the Vantoleone shatters the balance of power and plunges the city into chaos.
events.quote: After the attack on the Vantoleone, the fragile balance of power shattered completely, and the city descended into chaos.

events.summary: The Vanto Beatdown begins as a dance-battle at the Rose Room and becomes a citywide obsession.
events.quote: The Vanto Beatdown began as an improvised dance-battle at the Rose Room lounge.

events.summary: Kitt Kanto holds a note against converging assassins.
events.quote: As the assassins converged on Kitt Kanto, she struck a high note and held it, unbroken, for nearly a minute.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis smiles, his first conquest in over a thousand years.
Mikey the Mouth strikes a deal with Gregorio and never speaks again.
events.quote: Mikey "the Mouth" kept his nickname after he struck his deal with Gregorio, even though he never spoke another word.

events.summary: Investigators note that Altonio's fish thrive after his disappearance.
events.quote: Investigators observed that Altonio's beloved fish were thriving after his disappearance.

events.summary: Mr. Orfeo is jumped by a dozen Maestros agents and survives.
events.quote: Once he was jumped by a dozen Maestros agents.

relations.note: Ob Nixilis usurped the networks of power, the Maestros falling first
relations.quote: Xander's Maestros were the first to fall.
Xander's Maestros were the first to fall.

relations.note: Young viashino flock for her leadership
relations.quote: Young viashino flock to the Riveteers for Ziatora's leadership, eager to unleash their own inner dragons.
Ziatora's second-in-command has a habit of appearing when and where her enemies least expect her.
She watches Jetmir's back while her companions watch hers.

relations.note: Giada is the source of the Cabaretti's Halo
relations.quote: The source of the Cabaretti's Halo turned out to be a single teenage girl.

relations.note: Elspeth offers to help Giada escape
relations.quote: "I can get you out of here, but we have to go now."

relations.note: The Brokers descend from Old Capenna's paladins
relations.quote: Descended from Old Capenna's paladins, the Brokers are masters of defensive combat.

relations.note: The Cloud Spire is the Obscura's tower
relations.quote: The Obscura's Cloud Spire dominates the skyline, its eye a beacon of progress that sees all.
They wouldn't admit it, but some people join the Cabaretti just for the food.

relations.note: Jumped by a dozen Maestros agents
relations.quote: Once he was jumped by a dozen Maestros agents.
"Feed the rumor mills with delicious treachery. Bad blood between those two is a good deal for us." —Kamiz, Obscura Oculus
